required_variables: panel weight; VAT-specific internal task minutes; worker opportunity cost; recurring external VAT adviser/software spend; value added
identification_design: probability/reweighted panel measurement over a complete 12-month compliance cycle
success_condition: known inclusion/response weights; VAT-specificity classification; complete-cycle measurement; denominator aligned to same population
transport_boundary: External spend is a private-cost proxy and may include markups/rents; frame coverage may be narrower than national VAT population
forbidden_claim: Do not call this social real-resource c_VAT or national GDP loss.

required_variables: all private-cost variables plus provider-side VAT-specific labor/resource inputs or a separately justified spend-to-resource mapping
success_condition: provider-side resource use measured or conversion separately identified; no VAT remittance included; one-time transition cost excluded from recurring numerator
transport_boundary: Still frame-specific until national probability coverage/transport is established
forbidden_claim: Do not substitute accounting/adviser/software invoice value for real resources without an explicit mapping assumption.

formula_or_definition: nationally weighted recurring VAT-specific real resources / aligned national private-business value added
required_variables: C_VAT_REAL_RESOURCE_FRAME inputs; national probability inclusion weights; response/attrition adjustment; complete coverage or explicit uncovered-population treatment
identification_design: eligible public/statistical partner probability sample from Business Register, or another frame with known inclusion probabilities and demonstrated coverage
success_condition: sampling frame covers target population with known inclusion probabilities and valid nonresponse/calibration treatment; provider resource mapping satisfied
transport_boundary: Business Register direct researcher access is not assumed; Economic Census private-establishment margins alone exclude some units such as no-employee individual establishments
forbidden_claim: Do not publish national c_VAT from a recruited/nonprobability pilot or from Economic Census calibration alone.

target_population: firms eligible for and complying with pre-specified burden-reduction intervention
required_variables: randomized_offer; activation; internal VAT resource use; productive reassigned staff resource; baseline covariates
identification_design: randomized offer/encouragement of standardized VAT-specific workflow automation/assistance; primary ITT and pre-specified IV/CACE only if first stage is valid
success_condition: randomization intact; intervention materially reduces measured internal VAT resource use; reassignment measured rather than inferred from sales
transport_boundary: Local intervention effect on internal resources only; not automatically total-resource rho or abolition rho
forbidden_claim: Do not infer rho from cross-sectional burden-sales correlation or from treatment adoption without randomization/instrument.

formula_or_definition: treatment-induced productive resource reassignment / treatment-induced net total VAT-specific real-resource release
required_variables: RHO_INTERNAL_LOCAL variables plus external/provider VAT real-resource changes and transition resources
identification_design: randomized intervention with provider-side resource accounting
success_condition: net total resource first stage is measured and positive; provider resources and one-time transition inputs are accounted separately
transport_boundary: Mechanism-specific local effect; institutional VAT abolition removes a broader task set
forbidden_claim: Do not call internal-hours release model-compatible rho when provider/external resources are unmeasured.

formula_or_definition: population transport of model-compatible local redeployment fraction to full institutional VAT abolition
required_variables: RHO_MODEL_LOCAL plus representative treatment-effect transport covariates and abolition task coverage
identification_design: transport/generalization design not supplied by panel alone
success_condition: requires evidence that intervention resource-release mechanism and treated population transport to full abolition
transport_boundary: General-equilibrium labor demand and broader abolition transition remain separate
forbidden_claim: Do not point-estimate national rho from the local RCT alone.

formula_or_definition: abolition-only allocation effect excluding direct c_VAT*rho resource channel
identification_design: outside prospective burden panel primary design
success_condition: requires separate allocation design and national transport
transport_boundary: Panel firm outcomes may mix direct resource and allocation channels
forbidden_claim: Do not add reduced-form output effects to c_VAT*rho without decomposition.
